rev6.release_notes: Fusion add-in: Export tab > Export Model to G-SEND Drawing - one click sends the open design to G-SEND CAD CAM, which opens it as a new part straight into its drawing (front, top, right and iso views). Check (editor right-click) now also runs the program checks - e.g. two Z words on one line - and lists them with their line and operation.

cadcam.release_notes: Quick Setup for the lathe: with no model, CAM starts a mill OP1 with a one-click Mill / Lathe switch; the lathe window builds the part from steps (bar out of the jaws or whole bar, .030 face-off, steps by length or Z, front and back corner breaks) and programs face, OD rough, OD finish and part-off. Sketch: a click selects a line in blue and no longer puts up a dimension (Constrained; D still does); the hover line is thinner; the H / V / C rule marks show only on the shape hovered or selected (Constraints: All turns them all on). Ctrl+V: the copy follows the cursor - click to place it, or type a distance and Enter (a line stays parallel to its original). The Fix tool fixes a line's end that sits on the origin. Toolpaths: right-click a value box offers only Save Setting / Restore Setting; right-click the Tool row to save your default tool (Quick toolpaths too). Setup: right-click Machine or Milling / Turning to save it as the default. View cube: after a roll, type an angle and Enter. Quick program dimension lines are thinner.
